g.text: Immediate event preview identifier versus selected RP-window stratum
Cells: raw RP state count and stratum fraction of original RP mass. Columns are window-state strata; rows name the event's immediate preview.
Weights remain 1/n_RP_parent_case before every subset. Different identifiers do not establish a temporal transition or causal mode effect.
All original loss modes and empty categories remain explicit; NA = no selected RP mass. Event tags are not complete Fusion ancestry.
